summary.text: Thomas O'Mara is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 58 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

O'Mara, an attorney and former Chemung County district attorney, served in the State Assembly from 2005 to 2011 and has been in the State Senate since 2011; he is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Thomas O'Mara earned a B.A. from Catholic University of America and a J.D. from Syracuse University College of Law.

His professional experience includes serving as a partner with Davidson and O'Mara, Professional Company, as an assistant district attorney of Chemung County and New York County, as counsel for the Chemung County Industrial Development Agency, and as district attorney for Chemung County.
O'Mara served in the State Assembly from 2005 to 2011, represented State Senate District 53 from 2011 to 2013, and has represented District 58 since 2013.

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Finance Committee and the Investigations and Government Operations Committee, and is also assigned to the Energy and Telecommunications, Judiciary, Rules, Codes and Insurance committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, O'Mara faces James Bobreski (D).
